topic: Principles of Holography and Diffraction: Capturing the Whole Light

sections.title: Photography vs. Holography: The Missing Dimension
lecture_lines: Photography records only light intensity.
It captures a flat, 2D perspective.
Holography records both amplitude and phase.
This recreates the entire light field.
It captures the missing depth dimension.
animations: Show a 2D butterfly photo (#FFD700) on a flat plane.
Show a 3D butterfly model (#00FFFF) with light waves (#FFFFFF).
Label 'Amplitude' and 'Phase' next to the waves.
Rotate the camera around the 3D butterfly for parallax.
Fade in text '3D Reconstruction' near the butterfly.

sections.title: Prerequisite: Wave Interference and Coherence
lecture_lines: Holography requires coherent laser light.
Coherent waves oscillate in perfect sync.
Superposition creates stationary interference patterns.
animations: Show two sine waves (#00FF00) perfectly in phase.
Merge waves to show a larger peak (constructive).
Shift one wave and merge to show flatline (destructive).
Show overlapping circular ripples (#ADD8E6) from a top view.
Highlight the static 'fringe' pattern where ripples intersect.

sections.title: The Recording Process: Creating the Interference Pattern
lecture_lines: A beam splitter divides the laser.
The reference beam hits the plate.
The object beam reflects off subject.
They meet to form interference fringes.
This fingerprint stores the 3D data.
animations: Show laser (#FF0000) hitting a beam splitter.
Trace 'Reference Beam' path straight to the plate.
Trace 'Object Beam' reflecting off a chess piece (#C0C0C0).
Show waves from both paths meeting at the plate.
Zoom into plate to show a complex noise pattern.

sections.title: The Math of the Pattern: Complex Gratings
lecture_lines: Fringes act as a complex grating.
Light bends following the grating equation.
Variable spacing encodes the object's shape.
animations: Show a cross-section of plate with vertical lines (#FFFFFF).
Display 'd sin(\u03b8) = n\u03bb' (#FFFF00) with 'd' and '\u03b8' labels.
Show light rays (#FF0000) bending through variable spacing 'd'.

sections.title: The Reconstruction Process: Diffraction at Work
lecture_lines: Re-illuminate the plate with the laser.
Light diffracts through the fringe pattern.
This process reconstructs the original wavefront.
The object appears in 3D space.
It seems to float behind the plate.
animations: Shine 'Reference Beam' (#FF0000) on the developed plate.
Show light rays emerging and diverging from the plate.
Fade in semi-transparent chess piece (#C0C0C0) behind the plate.

sections.title: Real-World Application and Future Tech
lecture_lines: Rainbow holograms provide security on cards.
Diffraction enables high-density data storage.
Holography advances modern medical imaging.
animations: Show a holographic eagle (#D4AF37) shifting in rainbow colors.
Show white light beam (#FFFFFF) splitting into a spectrum.
Display a 3D data cube (#0000FF) with scanning lasers.
